integrity: Proved exact parameter classification with a separately executable symbolic consistency checker; finite numerical tests supplement, not replace, the proof.
scientific_limitations: Covers exactly the disk weight \(|z|^{2a}(1-|z|^2)^4\), \(a>-1\); no higher-order classification or stability bound. Priority could be affected by an unknown general root-location theorem.
title: Reentrant Bergman-kernel zeros at the fourth Jacobi boundary order
